gamemode_conquest_description.English: Raze all the other tribes' city from the face of the Square. Without any trace left.

building_ability_citadel.English: Expands border of its city to adjacent tiles. You can train units on it and defence bonus is applied.

tooltip_ability_mountaincitadel.English: Allows Citadel to be built on Mountain and provides defence bonus

tooltip_ability_watercitadel.English: Allows Citadel to be built on Water and provides defence bonus
